help.title: What I can do for you
help.intro: My strongest skill is creativity: designing things that carry a personal style instead of looking like a template. Bring an idea, and I will help you shape it, design it and build it.

offers.title: Game ideas & game design
offers.summary: Have a game idea that is still a sketch? I help turn it into rules, a core loop and something you can play.
points: Shape the concept: mechanics, progression and what makes it fun.
Build a quick browser prototype to test the idea early.
Rework a familiar genre into something new, like my PvZ survival roguelike.

offers.title: Personal websites
offers.summary: A site that looks like you: a portfolio, a landing page or a small web app with its own character.
points: Visual identity, layout and motion designed around you.
Fast static sites with light and dark themes and more than one language.
Domain, hosting and deployment set up end to end.

offers.title: Part-time on your project
offers.summary: Need an extra pair of hands? I join project teams part-time, from the idea stage to shipping.
points: Full-stack work: React, Node.js / NestJS and the cloud.
Technical scoping, code review and clear handover docs.
Comfortable leading a small team or working inside one.

traits.name: Creative, with a personal style
traits.detail: This site, a CV you can walk around in, a roguelike rework of a classic: I like things with character.

traits.name: Fast learner, wide range
traits.detail: Games, AI pipelines, video streaming, cloud: I pick up a new field quickly and connect the pieces.

points: Lead a team of 4 engineers across 2 product lines: architecture, sprint scoping, quality gates and releases.
Started TeleOperation: low-latency remote operation of heavy machinery, from the media path to failsafe behaviour on link loss.
Mentor mid and junior engineers through pairing, review standards and onboarding docs.
Built cloud microservices on AWS and GCP for EARTHBRAIN and two Atlassian Marketplace apps for enterprise Jira teams.
Made environments reproducible with Terraform and Serverless Framework.
